d: Long, flowing champagne blonde hair with straight bangs and two thick braided tails falls over the shoulders, paired with sharp, almond-shaped crimson eyes. The face is that of a young adult with a mature, poised expression and a slender, athletic build. The outfit consists of dark charcoal and gold plated armor including a breastplate, gauntlets, and thigh-high greaves, worn with a white undershirt and a blue waist-cape featuring gold trim and gold ring accents. Signature details include a gold crown with small white wings, a long floating black scarf with gold patterns, and a large silver broadsword.
